claims.statement: The at-rest cipher in `lib/crypto.ts` is AES-256-CBC with a fresh 16-byte random IV per call and a 32-byte key derived from `process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY` (a 64-character hex string). The wire format is `<iv_hex>:<ciphertext_hex>`, so the IV travels inside the encrypted column with no separate IV column; `decrypt` rejects inputs without a colon and throws on native decipher failure.
